name: PII Safe Documents (danyuchn/pii-guard)
category_title_en: What can I feed to AI?
summary_en: Creates a reversible, locally redacted working copy while treating the cloud LLM as untrusted. Prohibits the agent from opening, searching, or uploading the raw original.
summary_cn: 默认视云端大模型为不可信环境，在本地生成可逆的脱敏工作副本，主 Agent 严禁接触原始文件，任务完成后在本地还原并清理。

name: Scholar Safety (joshzyj/open-scholar-skill)
category_title_en: What can I feed to AI?
summary_en: Executes a pre-ingestion sensitivity scan before files are read into context. Gates IRB/HIPAA/restricted research data and offers local-only Bash analysis without raw-data transmission.
summary_cn: 在智能体读取文件前先执行本地敏感性扫描，对 IRB/HIPAA/受控学术数据设置门禁，支持仅在本地跑脚本分析而不把正文回传云端。

name: Skill Sanitizer (cyberxuan-XBX/skill-sanitizer)
category_title_en: What can I feed to AI?
summary_en: A local meta-security scanner that intercepts incoming SKILL.md files and checks for hidden prompt injections, suspicious bash operations, and exfiltration payloads before loading.
summary_cn: 在智能体加载第三方 SKILL.md 之前，扫描该技能文件内是否藏有提示词注入、恶意 Bash 命令或秘密回传外联代码。

name: PII-Shield (gregmos/PII-Shield)
category_title_en: What can I feed to AI?
target_persona: General Knowledge Workers, Legal & Financial Analysts
summary_en: Automatically detects personal identifiable information (names, emails, phones, SSNs) across files (.txt, .md, .pdf, .docx) before agent processing, replacing them with synthetic placeholders and restoring them locally.
summary_cn: 在智能体读取文件（.txt, .md, .pdf, .docx）时自动进行 PII 识别，将真实姓名、邮箱、电话等替换为合成占位符，任务完成后在本地还原。

name: mode-io/privacy-protector
category_title_en: What can I feed to AI?
summary_en: Identifies sensitive business credentials and customer contact details in prompt context, maintaining an ephemeral de-identification lookup table on local storage.
summary_cn: 识别上下文中的敏感凭证和联系信息，维护本地临时混淆映射表，防止外部大模型获取真实数据。
action_content: # Place privacy-protector/SKILL.md inside your agent skills directory

name: Anonymize Documents with Presidio
category_title_en: What can I feed to AI?
summary_en: Leverages Microsoft Presidio locally to scrub participant names, locations, and organizations before feeding transcripts to cloud LLMs.
summary_cn: 在本地调用微软 Presidio 引擎洗掉访谈对象姓名和机构，杜绝敏感学术调研数据外泄。

name: Pre-Input PII Sanitizer Prompt
category_title_en: What can I feed to AI?
summary_en: A two-stage prompting technique that forces the model to redact private entities first before performing substantive analysis.
summary_cn: 两阶段脱敏提示词，强制模型在进行实质性分析前先将输入文本中的人名、机构、联系方式和金额假名化。
action_content:
You are an expert privacy officer and data sanitization assistant.
I am going to provide a raw draft text.
Your ONLY task is to return a sanitized version of the text where:
1. All human names are replaced with brackets like [Person A], [Person B].
2. All specific organizational names, emails, phone numbers, and physical addresses are replaced with [Organization X], [Email redacted], [Location Y].
3. All monetary figures and specific account numbers are replaced with [Amount A], [Account Z].

Do NOT summarize, analyze, or interpret the text yet. Return ONLY the sanitized version and a private mapping table so I can verify.

name: Post-Generation Fact-Check (jwynia/agent-skills)
category_title_en: Which answers can I trust?
summary_en: Forces verification into a separate pass after generation: extracts every checkable claim, queries external sources, and marks statements as confirmed, contradicted, or unverified.
summary_cn: 在文本生成后启动独立的核查流程：逐条提取可核对的事实断言，检索外部权威信源，标明已证实、有矛盾或未证实（严禁用模型记忆自圆其说）。

name: Citation Faithfulness Checker (CanXiangCC/aminer-open-skill)
category_title_en: Which answers can I trust?
summary_en: Goes beyond checking if a source exists: fetches cited papers and verifies whether the cited text actually supports the claim attributed to it (SUPPORTED, NOT_IN_SOURCE, etc.).
summary_cn: 超越了“文献是否存在”，进一步调取文献原文，检验论文正文是否真的支撑 AI 声称的那个论据，标明引据一致性评级。

name: BibRef Verify (yzhao062/agent-config)
category_title_en: Which answers can I trust?
target_persona: Academic Researchers, Grant Writers, Paper Authors
summary_en: Audits an existing .bib bibliography for fabricated references and stale metadata using web search and Semantic Scholar, outputting a structured REFERENCE-CHECK.md audit report.
summary_cn: 对论文现有的 .bib 参考文献进行批量查伪与核实，识别虚构作者和失效 DOI，输出结构化的 REFERENCE-CHECK.md 审计报告。

name: Citation-Check-Skill (open-agent-skills)
category_title_en: Which answers can I trust?
summary_en: Parses citations and references in generated text, queries cross-reference APIs (Crossref, Semantic Scholar) to verify existence, and flags non-existent DOIs.
summary_cn: 自动提取生成文本中的参考文献与引文，调用 Crossref、Semantic Scholar 检验 DOI 和作者是否真实存在，标红虚构引文。

name: jkitchin/skillz (citation-verifier)
category_title_en: Which answers can I trust?
summary_en: Automatically validates bibliography items against Crossref and PubMed records, alerting users to phantom papers or retracted literature.
summary_cn: 批量校验学术论文参考文献条目，排查被撤稿论文和虚假引文，确保引用学术严谨性。
action_content: # Place citation-verifier inside .claude/skills/ or run via skillz

name: aidd-refine/05-fact-check
category_title_en: Which answers can I trust?
summary_en: Decomposes draft text into discrete factual claims, forces multi-source web verification, and rewrites unverified statements with epistemic hedging.
summary_cn: 将文本拆解为独立的事实断言（Claims），强制调用搜索工具求证，并对缺少确切依据的句子施加审慎对冲修饰。

name: Editorial Fact-Check & Quote Drift Protocol
category_title_en: Which answers can I trust?
summary_en: A two-pass journalistic editorial review designed to catch advanced hallucinations such as Quote Drift (altering quoted words) and Authority Masks.
summary_cn: 两阶段新闻编辑级核查提示词，专门排查引语漂移（Quote Drift，微妙篡改原话）和权威掩饰（用权威声望代替事实证据）。
action_content:
Perform a two-pass editorial fact-check on the provided text.
Pass A: Claim Verification
For every quote, statistic, or cited fact, output a structured table with: Location (line/paragraph), Claim Type, The Exact Claim, and a Status (CRITICAL, SUPPORTED, or PASSING).
Pass B: Editorial Flags (Apply only after Pass A)
Analyze the text for the following advanced errors:
* Ghost Citation: The source cannot be found.
* Citation Identity Drift: The underlying source exists, but the identifiers are mismatched.
* Quote Drift: The quoted language does not match the source exactly, altering meaning.
* Paraphrase Inflation: The draft makes a stronger claim than the original source supports.
* Authority Mask: The prestige of the cited source is doing the rhetorical work, but the citation adds no empirical evidence.

name: Epistemic Humility & Evidence Tagging Prompt
category_title_en: Which answers can I trust?
summary_en: Forces the model to tag every assertion as [VERIFIED], [INFERENCE], or [UNVERIFIED], suppressing hallucinated certainty.
summary_cn: 破除 AI 过度自信的作答模式，强行对输出中的每一句话进行证据置信度标注（[已证实]、[逻辑推论]、[未证实/假说]）。
action_content:
Please answer my inquiry with strict epistemic humility and evidentiary tagging.
Adhere to these rules:
1. For every assertion, append one of three tags:
   - [VERIFIED: Source name / link] - If you have high confidence based on established consensus or verifiable documentation.
   - [INFERENCE] - If the statement is a logical deduction rather than an empirical fact.
   - [UNVERIFIED / HYPOTHESIS] - If the assertion lacks authoritative grounding or is subject to ongoing debate.
2. If any piece of information cannot be verified, state "I do not have verified evidence for this point" rather than guessing.

name: The Fool (tech-leads-club/agent-skills)
category_title_en: When should I NOT listen to AI?
summary_en: A dedicated decision challenger that explicitly refuses to make decisions. Executes assumption probing, dialectical counterarguments, pre-mortems, and cognitive-bias scans to shatter premature consensus.
summary_cn: 愚者决策挑战者。原则是“不替用户做决定，只负责拆台与质疑”，通过隐性假设探测、辩证反驳、事前尸检与认知偏差扫描粉碎虚假共识。

name: Sycophancy Challenger (mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills)
category_title_en: When should I NOT listen to AI?
summary_en: Flips the agent from agreement to adversarial critique. Enforces anti-sycophancy rules: forbids retreating from a critique unless the user provides fresh, dispositive evidence.
summary_cn: 反迎合专精技能。强行将助手从吹捧赞同切换为对立批判模式，且明确规定“除非用户提供实质性新证据，否则禁止因用户反复辩解而妥协退让”。

name: Council Review (ngmeyer/council-review)
category_title_en: When should I NOT listen to AI?
summary_en: Implements a Diverse Multi-Agent Debate (DMAD) protocol combining Inversion, Decomposition, Analogy, and a mandatory Devil's Advocate pass to shatter single-agent groupthink.
summary_cn: 多样化多智能体辩论（DMAD）协议，综合运用反演法、任务分解、类比反思与强制魔鬼代言人轮次，打破单一大模型的盲目自洽。

name: orange2ai/devils-advocate-skill
category_title_en: When should I NOT listen to AI?
target_persona: Decision Makers, Product Managers, Policy Analysts
summary_en: Transforms the agent into an unsparing critic that attacks user assumptions, identifies hidden blind spots, and counteracts AI sycophancy.
summary_cn: 强制将 AI 切换为“不留情面的反方辩友”，专门挑出用户方案中的逻辑漏洞、未明言假设与迎合（Sycophancy）倾向。

name: jihlenburg/mad-skills (devils-advocate)
category_title_en: When should I NOT listen to AI?
summary_en: Spawns an adversarial sub-agent to stress-test plans and drafts across 8 distinct failure modes before finalization.
summary_cn: 启动对抗性子智能体，在方案定稿前从 8 个不同失败维度进行极限压力测试。

name: The Over-Reliance Interrogator Prompt
category_title_en: When should I NOT listen to AI?
summary_en: Demands the AI to step out of the advisor role and interrogate its own proposal for hidden assumptions and non-delegable responsibilities.
summary_cn: 让 AI 亲手拆穿自己方案的软肋，指出在极端边界下为何会失效，以及人类绝不能甩锅给算法的责任。
action_content:
You just provided the recommendation above. Now, step out of the advisor role and act as an independent, skeptical auditor.
Answer these three questions honestly:
1. Under what specific conditions or edge cases will this advice completely fail?
2. What hidden assumptions have you made that I, as the human, must personally verify before acting?
3. What ethical, legal, or contextual responsibilities cannot be delegated to an AI in this decision?

name: AI Provenance (noheton/f-ai2-r)
category_title_en: Can the output be published directly?
summary_en: Maintains an immutable provenance record of AI-assisted work (model versions, prompt hashes, verification states) and derives human-readable AI-use disclosures.
summary_cn: 自动记录人机协作轨迹（模型版本、提示词哈希、工具调用与验证状态），并从中推导出可信的人类可读 AI 使用披露说明。

name: Publish Gate (StiflerMaxwell/vertu-english-publishing-workflow)
category_title_en: Can the output be published directly?
summary_en: Enforces a strict PASS/FIX/BLOCK gate over drafts. Crucially, the writing/QA agent is forbidden from publishing directly; separate human authorization is required.
summary_cn: 对 AI 草稿执行 PASS/FIX/BLOCK 硬性发布门禁。编写与审校智能体被物理剥夺直接发布权限，必须依赖外部独立的人类授权回执。

name: PR AI Disclosure Gate (harlan-zw/harlan-agent-kit)
category_title_en: Can the output be published directly?
target_persona: Open Source Maintainers, Technical Writers, Developers
summary_en: Enforces a visible AI-writing disclosure whenever drafting release notes or PRs. The agent strictly refuses to submit or publish if the mandated disclosure is missing or altered.
summary_cn: 将 AI 披露做成代码提交与 PR 的机器强制门禁。在撰写说明时强制嵌入透明声明，声明若被删改则直接拒绝执行发布命令。

name: awesome-copilot/gdpr-compliant
category_title_en: Can the output be published directly?
summary_en: Enforces audit logging and data provenance records so developers can demonstrate compliance with IP and data retention rules.
summary_cn: 记录代码与文本的生成轨迹与数据来源，为机构出具可信审计日志，明确人机贡献界限。

name: AID / CRediT AI Usage Statement Generator
category_title_en: Can the output be published directly?
summary_en: Interactive questionnaire that formulates a transparent, standards-compliant AI Disclosure Statement for academic papers or corporate reports.
summary_cn: 依照学术界与专业出版规范，通过交互式问答自动生成严谨合规的 AI 使用声明（AI Disclosure Statement）。
action_content:
I have used AI assistance while preparing my document. Generate an honest, professional AI Disclosure Statement suitable for inclusion in an academic appendix, corporate report, or article footnote.

Please ask me the following questions one by one, then formulate the statement:
1. Which AI tool and model version were used? (e.g., Claude 3.7 Sonnet, ChatGPT-4o)
2. For which specific tasks was AI employed? (e.g., brainstorming, proofreading, code generation, translation, literature scanning)
3. What substantive portions were written entirely by humans?
4. What human verification steps were performed on the AI output?
